name: Canonical Four-Edge Face Profile of the 909-Concept Obstruction
definition: In the 909-concept four-vertex-path obstruction, take the canonical coordinate face determined by the path directions and the four-edge coordinate.
parameters: The face has type $(L,R)=(\{2\},\varnothing)$ and order $9$. The three components outside it have orders $284,288,328$.
properties: The projections of the three components outside the canonical face contain respectively $3,0,0$ vertices. Exactly the first piece has a nongated copy of the face. This realizes the first of the eight possible canonical face types.
